adapter.title: T480 MP4 Transcription Readiness
adapter.summary: Reports fixed read-only MP4 transcription deployment readiness through an injected transport probe.

use_cases: Check a fixed private transcription deployment before an approved application workflow.
fit_for: Read-only transcription preflight and runtime status.
not_for: Media upload, transcription job execution, cloud media processing, or model downloads.
limitations: A consuming application supplies the fixed probe; this adapter never accesses media or a host by itself.

provenance.changed_from: No source code, media path, credentials, or machine-local configuration copied; limited to fixed read-only diagnostics.

capabilities.name: transcription_readiness
capabilities.description: Read fixed private transcription deployment readiness.

operations.name: transcription_preflight
operations.summary: Read inbox, output, and worker-image readiness.
operations.retry_guidance: Retry after the consuming application restores the fixed transport or deployment.

operations.name: transcription_runtime_status
operations.summary: Read worker and local-model runtime readiness.
operations.retry_guidance: Retry after the consuming application restores the fixed transport or deployment.
